title: MigrationStatus
description: Migration status report for a single app or the core foundation. Reported at startup and on demand. Used by health surfaces — must contain no customer or domain data.

target.description: Which app or foundation component this status covers. Use 'core' for foundation core, or the app_id for app migrations.

schema_namespace.description: PostgreSQL schema namespace for this target.

current_version.description: Currently applied migration version. Null if no migrations have been applied.

expected_version.description: Expected migration version per app or foundation declaration.

migration_required.description: True if current_version does not match expected_version.

pending_migrations.description: Optional. Count of pending migration steps. Not content — only a count.

status.description: Migration state. 'current' means all expected migrations are applied. 'pending' means migrations are waiting. 'failed' means a migration error occurred. 'unknown' means state cannot be determined.

last_error_class.description: Error category if status is 'failed'. No free-form text.

checked_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp of when this status was last checked.
